ModMetaData.name: Fog of Pawn
ModMetaData.author: Brad Yin
ModMetaData.description:
Not all pawns are what they seem. Skills, passions, and traits can be hidden or faked when colonists join, creating uncertainty and emergent stories.
FOUR DECEPTION TIERS: • Truthful – All attributes shown accurately (default ~65%) • Slightly Deceived – Minor skill/passion alterations • Imposter – Low-skill pawns faking competence. When exposed, they drop disguise kits, suffer permanent social penalties, and trigger mood buffs if removed. • Sleeper – Elite pawns hiding their power. Trigger a 1-2 season incident chain with suspicious activity letters, culminating in a dramatic reveal where you choose to keep, capture, or exile them.
HOW IT WORKS: • Every pawn shows at least one real trait • Fogged skills function at true levels but with a 5% failure penalty when using faked skills • Hidden attributes reveal through time, mood, social interactions, skill use (XP), mental breaks, prisoner interrogation, and manual accusation
REVEALS: • Time + Mood – Longer stay and high mood increase reveal chances • Skill Use – XP accumulation may reveal true values • Social Interaction – Conversations can trigger reveals • Mental Breaks – Scale with time in colony • Prisoner Interrogation – Speeds up reveals significantly • Manual Accusation – Confront suspicious pawns directly
IMPOSTERS: When exposed, they drop disguise kits (reduces wealth), get permanent "Damaged Reputation" social debuff, and trigger colony mood buffs when killed/banished.
SLEEPERS: Rare high-value pawns with unique storylines. Their secrets are revealed through an incident chain over 1-2 seasons, not passive mechanics. At the dramatic reveal, you choose: Keep (mood buff + powerhouse), Capture (berserk), or Exile.
Fully configurable spawn rates, reveal mechanics, and penalty amounts in mod settings.
